hero: In a bright outpatient renal clinic in Quezon City, a Filipino nephrology fellow and a resident review a printed complete blood count and iron studies with a pale 61-year-old Filipino woman and her adult daughter seated across the desk; a wall calendar and a jalousie window behind them, warm and respectful mood, no text.

figures.teaches: Anemia in CKD comes from four linked failures, each pointing to a different action.
figures.content: Organ panel left: kidney with scarred peritubular cells labeled 'Oxygen sensor (HIF) - signal too small' sending a thin arrow 'Erythropoietin (too little)' to a bone marrow panel. Liver panel top: 'Hepcidin rises (inflammation, low clearance)' with a blocking bar on 'Ferroportin' at a gut cell and a macrophage, labeled 'Iron locked away (functional deficiency)'. Bottom left: three drip icons 'Gut bleeding (NSAIDs)', 'Dialysis circuit', 'Phlebotomy' labeled 'Iron lost (absolute deficiency)'. Marrow panel right produces few red cells with a timer icon 'Shorter red cell survival'. Bottom flow strip: 'Find the failure -> Correct causes and iron -> ESA if still needed -> Hb below 11.5 g/dL'.

figures.teaches: Raising hemoglobin toward normal with an ESA added harm without meaningful benefit in trials.
figures.content: Vertical hemoglobin scale 7 to 14 g/dL. Shaded band 'Start ESA on dialysis: at or below 9.0-10.0 g/dL (KDIGO 2026, 2D)'. Red line at 11.5 labeled 'Ceiling in adults on ESA: below 11.5 g/dL (1D)'. Above it two markers: 'CHOIR target 13.5 g/dL: events 17.5% vs 13.5% (HR 1.34), 1,432 patients' and 'TREAT target about 13 g/dL: stroke 5.0% vs 2.6% (HR 1.92), transfusion about 15% vs 25%, 4,038 patients'. Small footer: 'Hb is a surrogate; trial outcomes are what patients feel'.

figures.teaches: The KDIGO 2026 iron thresholds differ by dialysis setting and always pair ferritin with TSAT.
figures.content: Three columns. 'Hemodialysis': 'Start iron if ferritin <=500 ng/mL AND TSAT <=30% (2D)'; 'Route: intravenous (2D)'; 'Proactive approach (practice point)'. 'Not on dialysis or on PD': 'Ferritin <100 ng/mL and TSAT <40%, OR ferritin 100-300 ng/mL and TSAT <25% (2D)'; 'Route: oral or IV by shared choice (2D)'. 'Everyone': 'Withhold routine iron if ferritin >700 ng/mL or TSAT >=40% (practice point)'; 'Pause during systemic infection'; 'Profound deficiency without anemia: ferritin <30 and TSAT <20% (practice point)'. Footer: 'Draw iron studies before the first dose or transfusion'.

card: A pale older Filipino woman holding a laboratory result while a young doctor points to a hemoglobin value, clinic setting, no text.
